/seo/description.source_en: Busan one-day guided tour with ⟦G2⟧, Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory, Haeundae Blue Line Park area, ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G0⟧, and ⟦G3⟧.

/seo/metaDescription.source_en: 10.5-hour Busan small-group classic: ⟦G1⟧ Temple, Cheongsapo Blue Line, UN Memorial, ⟦G0⟧, ⟦G2⟧. 3 pickup points.

/hero/tagline.source_en: Busan's most-asked-for seven stops in a single small-group day

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: A 9.5-hour Busan highlights route with ⟦G2⟧ Temple, Cheongsapo, Haeundae Blue Line Park area, ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G0⟧, and ⟦G3⟧.

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A balanced Busan city tour for first-time visitors: seaside temple, Cheongsapo coastal viewpoint, optional Blue Line Park/Sky Capsule area, Korean War memorial history, colorful ⟦G0⟧, and a market-area finish near Jagalchi/Nampo-dong.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/title.tm: Что надеть и взять с собой

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/0.source_en: Comfortable walking shoes with grip — Gamcheon's hillside alleys and Yonggungsa's 108 stairs both need traction.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/1.source_en: Light layer for AC vehicle and the sea breeze at Yonggungsa.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/2.source_en: Camera or smartphone (Gamcheon and Cheongsapo are the photo highlights).

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/3.source_en: Cash or card for lunch (₩10,000–₩20,000), the optional Sky Capsule / Beach Train tickets at Cheongsapo, and the optional Busan Tower observatory.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/preview.source_en: Comfortable walking shoes with grip — Gamcheon's hillside alleys and Yonggungsa's 108…

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/1.source_en: Light rain: tour runs as scheduled — Yonggungsa under rain has its own atmosphere, and Gamcheon's alleys remain navigable.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/2.source_en: Heavy rain or storms: the guide may adjust the route because Yonggungsa's lower temple area can become slippery and Gamcheon's stairs can be unsafe.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/3.source_en: Typhoon-level weather: full refund or rebooking is offered.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/0.source_en: Pickup and drop-off at three Busan stations, air-conditioned mini-coach transport, licensed English-speaking guide.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/1.source_en: Excluded: lunch (₩10,000–₩20,000), optional Cheongsapo Sky Capsule (₩30,000–₩35,000 per 4-person capsule) or Beach Train (₩7,000), optional Busan Tower observatory (₩12,000).

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/2.source_en: All other site admissions are free: Yonggungsa, UN Cemetery, Gamcheon village, ⟦G0⟧.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/preview.source_en: Pickup and drop-off at three Busan stations, air-conditioned mini-coach transport,…

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/1.source_en: Chinese-speaking guide available on request — book 3+ days ahead.
/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/1.tm: Гид со знанием китайского доступен по запросу — бронируйте за 3 дня и более.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.source_en: Korean is spoken throughout the day for menus, signage, and stall interactions; the guide handles translation.
/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.tm: В течение дня корейский звучит в меню, на указателях и при общении с продавцами; перевод берёт на себя гид.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.source_en: Yonggungsa has 108 stone steps down to the temple (skippable — upper viewing platforms exist).
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.tm: В Йонгунса вниз к храму ведут 108 каменных ступеней (их можно пропустить — наверху есть смотровые площадки).

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.source_en: Gamcheon is a hillside village with steep alleys and stairs throughout the photo route — traction shoes essential.
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.tm: Камчхон — деревня на склоне, и весь фотомаршрут идёт по крутым переулкам и ступеням; обувь с хорошим сцеплением обязательна.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/4.source_en: Jagalchi indoor market is flat but crowded.
